scientific_integrity: All nontrivial q-color periodic-state counts are derived analytically; independent finite checker tests are corroboration and do not replace proofs. Residual novelty risk from unpublished or unindexed equivalent enumerations is retained.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the synchronous, threshold-one q-state Greenberg–Hastings model on complete bipartite graphs only. No claim about basins, preperiods, stochastic variants or other graphs. The 1978 original journal description predates the earliest exact day verified in the archival preprint record used for the first_public_date field; no day within 1978 is imputed.
title: Parity-selective periodic excitation on complete bipartite graphs
